note: Story wording for the Freight Fate paper, written by the director thread on 2026-11-22. Task N1 copies this to data/freight-fate-paper-phrases.json in orinks-net. A slot is a word in braces. 'always' lists the slots a story of that kind always has. The renderer may use a variant only when every slot it names is present, and every kind has at least one variant that needs only its 'always' slots. The slot 'when' is present on every story and is never listed: it reads 'this week' in an edition that covers one week, and 'in the last two weeks' (three, four and so on, the number spelled out up to twelve) in an edition that also covers weeks with no edition of their own. No section heading or table caption names the week, and the only headline that does is record_week_miles, which runs only in an edition that covers one week. Numbers arrive already formatted (1,412). A kind with 'one' and 'other' picks by its count slot. Do not reword without the director: this is player-facing text.
